title: CAB530M12BM3 / CAB530M12BM3T 1200 V, 530 A all-SiC half-bridge module (62 mm BM3) data sheet, Rev. 5, August 2026
method: Table values copied from the datasheet text with a fetch tool (no curve digitized). R_DS(on) is the 'Devices Only' value; typ/max column assignment of '2.67 3.55' (25 C) inferred from column order (Min/Typ/Max header); no max given at 150 C and no 175 C value. Switching energies stated at 25/125/150 C only. R_thJC is a single (typ) value 0.065 C/W, no max; no case-to-heatsink resistance stated. T_VJ(op): -40 to 150 C operation, 175 C 'intermittent with reduced life'. Z_thJC given only as a graph (Fig. 17); no Foster/Cauer r_i/tau_i in the datasheet text (Wolfspeed distributes Cauer parameters separately, not fetched).

mosfet.I_D_note: V_GS 15 V, T_C 90 C, T_VJ <= 175 C (Note 2: I_D(max) = sqrt(P_D / R_DS(typ)(T_VJmax, I_Dmax))); 719 A at T_C 25 C
mosfet.I_DM_note: t_P max limited by T_VJmax, V_GS 15 V, T_C 25 C
mosfet.R_DSon_cond: V_GS 15 V (and 18 V), I_D 530 A, devices only
mosfet.E_cond: V_DS 600 V, I_D 530 A, V_GS -4/+15 V, R_G(ext) 1.5 ohm, L_sigma 15.6 nH (inductive; conditions printed once for the E_on/E_off block)
mosfet.V_SD_cond: body diode V_F, V_GS -4 V, I_F 530 A
